title: NBI arrests 4 suspected human traffickers in Navotas, Caloocan

blocks.text: The National Bureau of Investigation has arrested four suspected human traffickers in two separate operations in Navotas and Caloocan City for allegedly offering Filipino minors to foreign customers through online platforms and arranging in-person sexual encounters in the Philippines.
